Set B tracks the wiring schedule and notes more faithfully (items 31-34, 50, 150, 151, NFDS rating, L1/L2/N with NO GND, copper-to-GND), though it also invents "Voltage Organizer"/"Current Organizer" input claims with fabricated quotes, mislabels the 2-1/2"C. conduit as cable 150 diameter, and truncates the instrumentation-panel conductors to L1, L2.
